response.sql:
WITH sex_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) as avg_acl_igg,
    AVG(e.ANA) as avg_ana
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  GROUP BY p.SEX
),
ana_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ana) as mean_ana
  FROM sex_averages
)
SELECT 
  sex_averages.SEX,
  sex_averages.avg_acl_igg,
  sex_averages.avg_ana,
  sex_averages.avg_ana / ana_mean.mean_ana as ana_ratio
FROM sex_averages
CROSS JOIN ana_mean

assumptions.assumption: Patients with NULL values in the SEX column are included as a separate group in the grouping, rather than excluded

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude patients with NULL sex values from grouping (only non-NULL sexes appear in results)

  SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) as avg_acl_igg,
    AVG(e.ANA) as avg_ana

  WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.SEX
),
ana_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ana) as mean_ana
  FROM sex_averages

SELECT 
  sex_averages.SEX,
  sex_averages.avg_acl_igg,
  sex_averages.avg_ana,
  sex_averages.avg_ana / ana_mean.mean_ana as ana_ratio
FROM sex_averages
CROSS JOIN ana_mean
